rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule's own mechanical diagnostic: awk '/<!-- maintainer -->/{f=1} f' <file> | grep -inE '\b(settled|retired|no longer|used to be|was changed to|previously|swapped|dropped|renamed)\b[^.]{0,80}[0-9]{4}' -> 0 hits (empty = passing per rule text). Broader transition-verb sweep finds one candidate at L106: 'M6 deck order (2026-09-02, three-beat re-cut, slides moved and re-tiered, body text untouched pending cards)' -- dated-provenance-header shape matching the corpus's blessed 84/101-file convention; 'moved'/'re-tiered' describe the pass type (no reconstructable from/to), and the clause also carries a real forward-binding fact ('body text untouched pending cards'). All other maintainer notes are dated attribution + standing constraint + do-not-restore/re-flag directives, the explicitly licensed shape (L57, L61 'Cut ... Do not restore'; L65, L70, L72, L74 dated + binding constraint + 'future judges should not re-flag').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 voice quintet read: Big Idea (L4) and WYL bullets (L13-16) lead Boris-factual/concrete; 'Despair not.' (L26) is peer-warmth Godin register, already named in the rule's own text as a passing instance of the slang-Godin-plausibility test ('Pass 1 + fail 2 + fail 3 -> keep (oldskool, Despair not., trusted on vibes)'). No negation-callout, no atmospheric imagery. Grep for '**Remember', 'Hold onto', 'Keep in mind', 'Never forget' -> 0 hits. Grep for cargo/theatre/ritual/tourist/poster -> 0 hits. Grep for 'just a simple'/'trust the agent'/leash/niceness -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Klaassen credited inline by name with link at L9 (satisfies credit-originator obligation). Grep for \bAntti\b|the creator|the author|course creator|training creator -> 0 hits in body (lines 1-54). Grep for sentence-initial We/we or \bour\b -> 0 hits. No belief-number references present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: mechanical: body-view grep /\bthe student\b/ over body projection -> 0 hits; pattern proven against planted violation (status CLEAN). Body consistently uses second person ('You walk in...', 'You can still rescue it...').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No maintainer-only jargon (backpressure, three-pattern, grill-me, self-compound, compound-by-subtraction) appears in body; the maintainer explicitly documents the design choice to withhold 'backpressure' at L68 ('M6 assigns no reading on it and does not restate the word').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L26 'You lose a bit of value but you can still do this module's exercises. Despair not.' names a genuine cost then a real permission, not a reassurance bolted onto an already-complete delegation sentence (the swept-to-zero pattern this rule targets); it answers a real 'am I doomed' anxiety inside the licensed rescue exception (maintainer L70). Grep for 'no penalty'/'it's OK if'/'not a downgrade'/'not on the hook' -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Klaassen named once, at L9, inside `## Prework` -- a pre-read/reading-list item, exempt from the cap entirely per the 2026-08-15 carve-out ('Prereads and links don't count'). Zero countable body-prose mentions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for flagged phrases (not an aspirational/not a vendor/this isn't marketing/the real practitioners/unlike consultancy decks/grounded in actual/not theoretical/from the person running it) and for 'vendor' alone -> 0 hits in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No LLM-internal vocabulary (statistical default/token/embedding/retrieval/inference/fine-tuning/prompt engineering/orchestration/schema/frontmatter) in body. 'worktree', 'kit', 'gaps' are established M4-M6 arc vocabulary by this terminal module; 'handoff prompt' (L16) is this module's own new coinage, introduced inside `## What You'll Learn` (a canonical signposting section) and landed operationally in this same module's own lecture (the-handoff-prompt.md, L36).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L24 closer 'stay with the rescue and read it afterwards' -- 'it' resolves singularly to 'the lecture' named two clauses earlier, no ambiguous referent. No bypass-the-agent punchlines ('write that yourself', 'go fix it', 'do it manually') found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for bark/order/command/whip/force/drag/push around/boss/shout at/snap at/lecture/scold -> one hit at L24, 'lecture' as a noun ('the room starts the lecture') referring to the scheduled classroom activity, not the combative verb 'to lecture [someone]' describing human-agent interaction. False positive; verb list otherwise 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All headers in body (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Human close, Optional challenges) are canonical module-shape section names, exempt by the template's structural carve-out; none carries a spatial/structural metaphor mismatch or an unpaired 'other X'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat -- the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty-negation 'X, not Y' constructions in body. 'This slot is a human round: talk, compare, no prompts.' (L43) is deictic-shaped but falls under the rule's own named exception ('legitimate when it NAMES a concept') -- it defines the slot's mode, matching the maintainer's check_pedagogy §27 mode-defining-cue rationale (L72). No bold-label echoes (WYL bullets bold a verb, e.g. **Diagnose**, not a restated noun label). No citation/appendix duplication -- the L9 Klaassen gloss ('He measures a verifier before trusting it and runs several in parallel') states a distinct fact, not a repeat of body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing -- run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Two superlative hits in body: L24 'never started' (scoped to the specific M5 session, a conditional about one artifact, not a world-claim) and L53 'never fired at all' (scoped to 'your kit', the student's own configuration -- the rule's own 'corpus we control' carve-out). Neither is an unscoped claim about how the world works; no counterexample applies.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A sentence saying how you'd know points at the outcome, not the nearest artifact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'X tells you whether Y' / 'you'll know it worked when' self-witnessing clauses in body. Closest candidate, Big Idea L4 ('or you will find it again next week'), is an external falsifiable consequence (rediscovering the gap), not a self-referential instrument judging itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Say it once, at its most concrete, then at most one sentence that generalises it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No abstract-twin restatement, no adjacent-artifact narration (body doesn't restate what the linked lectures/exercises will say), no widening qualifier, no second-announcement duplication across the body's four sections. The two rescue blockquotes (L24, L26) address different failure depths (stalled/crashed session vs. total loss), not a restated idea.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No corrective-gap framing ('you're missing X'), no ability-tier phrasing ('at your scale'/'for a beginner'/'a senior would already know'), no tourist/practitioner-style identity split with an unreachable criterion. Body frames the module as diagnostic work the student walks into (L22), not a deficiency verdict.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'worktree' (L20, L24) and 'kit' (L16, L53) are established AE101 arc vocabulary by M6 (terminal module); 'handoff prompt' (L16) is this module's own new coinage, introduced inside the canonical `## What You'll Learn` signposting section and landed operationally in this same module's lecture (the-handoff-prompt.md). Body spells out 'Module 5' (L20) rather than relying on the M2+ bare-MN carve-out -- the more conservative form, not a violation either way.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context -- use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L13 uses 'memory' correctly as a persistent-artifact destination ('memory, sharper verifier, or new skill'); no conflation with runtime 'context'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body -- THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The two rescue blockquotes (L24, L26) are covered by the file's own maintainer accept-note (L70): 'M6 opener rescue + accept-loss callouts -- deliberate exception to check_student_facing.md rule 5 ... Future judges should not re-flag.' Time-critical rescue (scrollback/session-state risk), matching the rule's own stated boundary exception.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body voice (diagnostic, practical, competence-as-posture) matches M6's own stated target mood (Meta section: 'practitioner fluency'); no imported M1 joyful-creation or M4/M5 unease register.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout-box or boxed-citation shape in body; the one citation present (Klaassen, L9) is the rule's own preferred default: a one-line inline citation inside `## Prework`, not a boxed 'research says' aside.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Optional challenges (L50-53) name build outcomes (skill loader, eval, shipped skill, monitoring system) without instructing manual editor/terminal mechanics as a forcing function outside the agent conversation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer -- every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L14 correctly qualifies the layer: './CLAUDE.local.md', never bare 'CLAUDE.md'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: mechanical: body-view grep /—/ over body projection -> 0 hits; pattern proven against planted violation (status CLEAN).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No non-canonical subsection headers present in body requiring the verb-lead test; all headers (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Human close, Optional challenges) are canonical module-shape names, exempt by the rule's own carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All body links (L9, L28, L30, L32, L34, L36, L38, L45) use the linked page's actual title as link text, verified against the Meta section's own title statements -- e.g. L36 '[Agents that build agents](lectures/the-handoff-prompt.md)' and L45 '[There is no last turn](lectures/agents-that-build-agents.md)' match Meta's 'titled Agents that build agents' / 'titled There is no last turn, last' despite filename mismatch. No code-span or bare-filename link text; no ordinal ('Step N') cross-references.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No first-authored-use collision terms (memory/skill/rule/plan/agent/subagent) introduced in body without disambiguation context, and none of the ambiguous-deictic patterns ('here' next to write/save/note/put/drop) appear.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for Claude/agent/LLM over body -> 0 hits; the discrimination this rule governs has no instance to apply to in this file's body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split (all trainings).
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'session' used correctly throughout (M5 session, packaged session, partial session, L20-26); 'task' used correctly (L22, 'two sessions of the same task'); the one noun-'run'-shaped word in body, L9 'runs several in parallel', is verb-run describing Klaassen's own practice, explicitly unrestricted by this rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for tomorrow/overnight/this morning/tonight/next morning/yesterday/last night -> 0 hits in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for the banned headers/prefixes (Pause before you promote/Meta-moment/reflection beat/Step back/Moment of truth/sit with/let it land/take a moment/give yourself space/breathe/be present with/pause and reflect) -> 0 hits. 'Human close' (L40) and 'This slot is a human round: talk, compare, no prompts.' (L43) name a room activity (a discussion round), not a self-aware pedagogy cue announcing reflection.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is post-lean-pass (maintainer L61, 2026-08-25 M3/M6 shorten) and reads tight; no implementation-detail-before-point-of-use, administrative aside, or maintainer-reasoning leak identified across the four body sections.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forward-looking training-wide callout closers present in body (no 'watch for X across the rest of training'-shaped sentence); the two rescue blockquotes close on immediate, scoped instructions, not arc-wide gestures.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L20 restates the worktree path convention at the point the student opens the session ('Open a fresh session in the Module 5 worktree, `../<repo-name>-m5`'), consistent with the Meta section's stated training-architecture default -- the rule's own compliant shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body vocabulary draws from the spine (checks, evals, memory, verifier) rather than inventing neutral synonyms for existing house terms; 'handoff prompt' names this module's own new artifact, not a swap-out of an established spine word.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L24 uses the compliant form directly: 'a "continue"-prompt is usually enough' -- prompt as noun, not 'typing continue' or 'tell it to continue'. Grep for 'typing '/'type in'/'say to Claude'/'tell it to' -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself -- subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest candidate, L24 'M6 starts by reading; before it writes, decide whether to wait, stop M5, or accept the partial session as the artefact.' -- subject test flags 'M6' as the module referring to its own structure, but the deletion test does not confirm: removing the clause loses the actionable three-way decision (wait / stop M5 / accept partial session) that the framing clause exists to justify, so it isn't pure arc-positioning NVA. 'This slot is a human round...' (L43) is about the immediate beat, not a later/elsewhere arc claim, and is covered by the maintainer's check_pedagogy §27 mode-defining-cue rationale (L72).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood is a design constraint, not a garnish.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Meta section states the target: 'practitioner fluency ... competence-as-posture', with named wrong-edits including compliance-feel ('build the eval, pass the gate'). L15's WYL bullet -- 'Read the checks you built as evals: a pass rate, not a pass' -- explicitly refuses binary-gate framing in favor of a continuous read, working against rather than into the named wrong-edit. Start-here beats are session-launch/setup, mood-exempt per this rule's own floor clause.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named.
rules_evaluated.evidence: One-sentence mood statement: the body leaves the student in competence-as-posture practitioner fluency (diagnostic verbs, concrete artifacts, no ceremony) and sets up the close/handoff beats (Human close, agents-that-build-agents) to hold the room's own conversation rather than more instruction. Matches Meta's stated target mood; setup-shaped 'Start here' launch instructions (L18-20) are mood-exempt per this rule's own floor clause.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Module title/Big Idea pairs a diagnostic noun ('gaps') with a constructive discipline verb-phrase ('build the loop'); it is not primarily a failure-mode label (compare the rule's banned examples: fabrication/violation/hallucination). 'gap' functions as diagnostic material the discipline resolves, not the title's own failure-word.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity check.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The file's own maintainer block (L153) pre-empts this exact check: "'Story of Module 6' lands after the exercise ... bosser-strategy:content-strategy-agentic-engineering-101.md § M6 in detail carries the same order -- the module file is the decision; a strategy judge reading a stale copy of the doc will re-flag the order. Do not reorder to match a doc." Honoring that explicit maintainer directive rather than re-deriving a sequencing complaint against a doc the maintainer has already flagged as possibly stale.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape -- capability register, not syllabus.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All four WYL bullets (L13-16) lead with concrete construction/diagnosis verbs (Diagnose, Cut, Read, Turn) and a named artifact (gaps, one rule from ./CLAUDE.local.md, checks-as-evals, a handoff prompt); none carries a Bloom-tag parenthetical, pedagogical-mechanism tail, author-defense aside, or didactic taxonomy stamp. 'Cut one rule from ./CLAUDE.local.md the diagnosis killed' (L14) matches the rule's own worked-correct shape (verb leads, file is destination, not subject).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Exercise headers pass the build-squint test.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: This rule governs H1 headers inside EXERCISE files (exercises/*.md); this is a module file, whose own `##` headers are all canonical module-architecture section names (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Human close, Optional challenges), none of which is an exercise-file H1 the build-squint test applies to.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: Maintainer accept-note explicitly names this rule: "`## Key Concepts` cut whole (Antti 2026-09-02...). Terminal-module exception to `module-shape.md` § Key Concepts and `check_strategy_tie_in.md` §§5–6; judges should not re-flag." Body has no `## Key Concepts` section at all to test theme-recurrence against.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs, not standalone section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
The `**What happened:**` block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it (Antti-directed 2026-08-12, mandation removed from `curriculum/exercises/README.md`).
Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
One doc per scarce-attention audience; delta-only.
Trainer-facing text is self-contained.
Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module — never repeat same Debrief.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
Simulation personas never alone.
No meta-ask when student has already decided.
`.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
Four sharing strategies (Agents 101 M7 canonical) — use verbatim.
Agents 101 M2+ Debrief — canonical shape.
Trust the prompt over the scaffold.
Epistemic mood ≠ punitive mood.
No placeholders inside fences.
Every prompt block: one-sentence action lead-in.
Canonical shape — lead-in, label with destination, blank line, fence.
Installed Skills invoke by name, never path.
Chain by back-reference + deterministic path, never invented alias.
Chained-prompt isolation — don't leak downstream pipeline.
No session-resets mid-phase.
Multi-sample methods need structural enforcement.
Markdown shout (`**bold**`, `*italic*`) inside fenced prompts = dead weight in Claude Code.
Runtime-fork prompts: paired divs, shared chip.
Runtime-mechanical scaffolding asymmetry — MORE in less-fluent fork, not less.
Append-vs-integrate — name integration mode on regeneration with new context source.
Citation discipline — extend cite-or-flag scope + quote supporting sentence.
Niceness tax — name the edge or pin the line on regeneration.
Question-dump default — `in turn` too soft; two legal shapes.
Overwrite anxiety — name overwrite default on regeneration.
Preamble before action — design around it.
Self-critique register, not defense, when Claude interrogates own work.
Minimal hand-off + Claude self-augments for send-off prompts.
Grill before save — collaborative quality at artefact assembly.
Tell me what you wrote, not show me what you'll write.
Prompt-body edits require maintainer approval — registry files AND inline blocks.
Artifact destinations are explicit subpaths, never naked filenames (Agents 101-specific).
Don't restate session CWD inside prompt body.
`subagent` allowed in prompt blocks; explain why after prompt.
Maintainer-approval edits — ONE-AT-A-TIME, PRIORITY-ORDERED, FOUR-FIELD cards.
Name consumer at write time — `Save it as <path>` requires downstream reader.
Strong-bold prompt label is exactly `**Prompt**` — custom labels break renderer.
Normal work request before orchestration.
Live-test corrections preserve operator workflow.
Prompts live in registry; module/exercise/lecture files reference by marker.
Module names in prompt prose are fine — they ground the session.
Git-output greps asserting exact-N need multi-result fallback.
Disambiguation, anchors, and decision logic that bind Claude live INSIDE prompt fence.
Repeated Q&A → premature re-edits. Separate iteration from persistence.
Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.
Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.
Declare `permission-mode:` when paste requires specific Claude Code mode.
Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
Artifact-vs-STOP tail ordering — last imperative wins.
Headless-runner discipline — tail every prompt with no-AUQ guard.
Long-running prompts stream progress — never go silent.
A leading-looking line can be a forcing function; prefer the simpler prompt.
Prompt paths match Builder scope.
Output shape — trust Claude's defaults, don't pad.
"Add X and regenerate" is a trap.
Vary closings deliberately.
CTO-repeatable test.
No stylized phrase-pairs.
Strip strategy-doc vocabulary.
Earn every term.
No M-number cross-references.
"What you build" = 20–30 words.
Describe failure modes, don't name them.
Agency on right noun.
No em dashes on site.
No "What research says" callout boxes.
Don't describe mood arc externally.
Ownership claims scope to customer-built artifacts.
Numbers carry their denominator + axis.
Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
